text:
sophie.ae: Kicking off technical scoping for ACME POC. Customer wants 3 potential flows. Need to align use cases, success metrics, timeline, and any enterprise blockers. I can do a sync Wed but dropping notes here first.

maria.se: Thanks — quick recap of the candidate use cases we talked about on the call:
- Support drafting + automated replies (retrieval + generation)
- KB search + reranking for high-precision answers
- Proposal assistant that drafts templated responses for reps
Which two should we prioritize for the 4-week run?

leo.eng: My read: prioritise Support drafting + KB rerank. Both reuse embeddings and chat endpoints, fastest to integrate. Proposal assistant is heavier (document assembly + structured slots).

tina.pm: Agreed. Success criteria proposal: 
- Integration: demo-ready integration in 2 weeks (ingest KB, serve answers)
- Quality: MRR >= 0.45 on the eval prompts for KB rerank; F1 > 0.6 on reply extraction for support
- Latency: P95 < 500ms for single-turn chat on Dedicated; P95 < 250ms for embeddings lookup
- Cost: unit token cost <= our estimate (we'll refine)
If we hit those, customer signs for Dedicated.

anna.sec: Security checklist items I need confirmed before any customer data ingest: 
1) Data residency (they want EU-only)
2) KMS/HSM for keys, audit logs retention 1y
3) PII handling: redaction + opt-out from logs
4) Soc2/ISO attestation copies to send to them
Can we meet those?

maria.se: Yes to EU region deploy on Redwood Private or Dedicated in EU. KMS integration possible — we'll surface docs. For logs we can enable token-level redaction and sample off. I'll attach config snippets.

leo.eng: On implementation: we'll use two endpoints: 
- Embeddings: POST /v1/embeddings -> index into vector DB (batch up to 512)
- Chat/Responses: POST /v1/responses with system+user prompts, stream support on our side
Sample prompt for rerank eval:```
System: You are a search reranker.
User: Return the top 3 KB articles for the question.
```
Eval harness will run N=300 seed queries from ACME. Need their labeled ground truth.

sophie.ae: Pricing and discounts question from procurement: if they commit to 6 months Dedicated reserved capacity for steady throughput, what discount bands apply? Also: will we charge for evaluation tokens during the POC?

maria.se: Typical: 15% off for 6mo commit, 25% for 12mo enterprise deals — final depends on capacity. We usually waive a small amount of eval traffic (up to X tokens) but large eval runs billed or offset as credits. I'll loop in finance if we need exceptions.

tina.pm: Timeline suggestion (4-week aggressive POC):
Week 0: Kickoff, NDA and data access, security Q sent
Week 1: KB ingest, embedding pipeline, baseline rerank + small eval set
Week 2: Prompt tuning, chat flows for support, run full eval harness
Week 3: Latency/cost optimization (batching, quantized models), A/B test variants
Week 4: Demo, results report, contract discussion
Is that realistic?

leo.eng: Yes but call out risks: KB labeling delay (customer must provide ground truth), network egress for on-prem ingestion can add 3-5 days. Also need to confirm GPU SKU for Dedicated to hit <500ms P95.

anna.sec: Also add security gating: we won't ingest production PII until DPA signed. For the eval set they can provide anonymized queries or we can synthetic augment.

sophie.ae: Action items: 
- @maria.se: send EU deploy + KMS configuration docs + sample RBAC policy (due EOD tomorrow)
- @leo.eng: draft the minimal infra runbook with expected GPU SKUs and perf targets (due Fri)
- @anna.sec: send security questionnaire answers and DPA template to ACME legal (due Wed)
- @tina.pm: finalize success criteria + eval plan and share template (due Thu)
- @sophie.ae: will confirm commercial ask re: 6mo reserved discount and how eval tokens are handled (I will loop in finance)

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: ACME POC kickoff — Wed 14:00 UTC. Calendar invites sent to participants. :calendar:

maria.se: I'll start building the eval harness this afternoon. Quick Q — do we want to run both relevance (MRR) and answer-exactness (EM/F1) or just one?

tina.pm: Run both. MRR for rerank, F1/EM for support reply correctness. We'll weight 60/40 MRR:F1 in the success score.

leo.eng: Also want to add monitoring hooks to Redwood Console: per-route latency, token breakdown, and a weekly cost projection chart. I'll add dashboards to the runbook.

sophie.ae: Perfect. I'll message the ACME buyer with the plan and proposed kickoff date. If anything else pops up, drop it here. :thumbsup:
